spotlights.tagline: A Fedora Atomic image built for games: Steam, HDR and handheld support come ready, and an update that breaks something rolls back.
A calm, focused desktop built around search and the Activities overview. Make it your own with Shell extensions.
Scrollable tiling. Windows open in columns on an endless strip, so a new window never squeezes the ones you already have.

wallpaper_spotlight.tagline: A fresh pick from orangc's walls every time you open the app. Set it as your background in one click.

ideas.name: Status bar
ideas.description: A panel pinned to a screen edge, like Waybar.

ideas.name: App launcher
ideas.description: A pop-up search that starts apps, like fuzzel or Walker.

ideas.name: Dock
ideas.description: App icons that stay on screen, like Dash to Dock.

ideas.name: Notification daemon
ideas.description: Show notifications as your own floating cards, like mako.

ideas.name: Live wallpaper
ideas.description: Animated or video wallpapers, like awww or mpvpaper.

ideas.name: Lock screen
ideas.description: Your own lock screen, like hyprlock or gtklock.

ideas.name: Screenshot tool
ideas.description: Capture the screen or a region, then annotate it.

ideas.name: Screen recorder
ideas.description: Record the screen or a window, like Kooha.

ideas.name: Clipboard history
ideas.description: Keep a history of what you copy, like cliphist.

ideas.name: Idle daemon
ideas.description: Dim or lock the screen after you step away, like hypridle.

ideas.name: Keep-awake switch
ideas.description: Stop the screen from sleeping while something runs.

ideas.name: Night light
ideas.description: Warm the screen colors in the evening, like wlsunset.

ideas.name: Blur behind your app
ideas.description: Ask the compositor to blur what is under your window.

ideas.name: On-screen keyboard
ideas.description: Type with touch or a pointer, like wvkbd.

ideas.name: Display profiles
ideas.description: Switch monitor layouts when you plug in, like kanshi.

ideas.name: Window tiling
ideas.description: Snap windows into layouts, like Tiling Shell or Krohnkite.

protocols.name: XDG shell
protocols.description: Gives apps normal windows and popups.

protocols.name: Layer shell
protocols.description: Lets a program draw on desktop layers: background, bottom, top and overlay.
protocols.useful_for: Status bars, docks, launchers, notifications, wallpapers

protocols.name: XDG decoration
protocols.description: Decides whether the app or the compositor draws title bars.

protocols.name: XDG activation
protocols.description: Lets one app hand focus to another.
protocols.useful_for: Opening links and files in another app

protocols.name: Background effect
protocols.description: Asks the compositor to blur what is behind a surface.

protocols.name: Screen copy (wlroots)
protocols.description: Copies the contents of a monitor into a buffer.

protocols.name: Image copy capture
protocols.description: Captures monitors or windows into buffers. The standard successor to wlroots screen copy.

protocols.name: Monitor capture source
protocols.description: Picks a monitor as the source for image copy capture.

protocols.name: Window capture source
protocols.description: Picks one window as the source for image copy capture.

protocols.name: Export DMA-BUF
protocols.description: Exports monitors as GPU buffers, without copying.

protocols.name: Window export (Hyprland)
protocols.description: Captures a single window on Hyprland.

protocols.name: Window management
protocols.description: Lists open windows and lets a program focus, minimize or close them.

protocols.name: Window list
protocols.description: Lists open windows, without control over them.

protocols.name: Workspaces
protocols.description: Lists workspaces and lets a program switch between them.

protocols.name: Data control (wlroots)
protocols.description: Reads and sets the clipboard without a focused window.

protocols.name: Data control
protocols.description: Reads and sets the clipboard without a focused window.

protocols.name: Session lock
protocols.description: Lets a program lock the session and draw the lock screen.

protocols.name: Idle notifier
protocols.description: Tells a program when the user has been away for a while.

protocols.name: Idle inhibit
protocols.description: Keeps the screen awake while a window is visible.

protocols.name: Security context
protocols.description: Marks sandboxed apps, so the compositor can limit what they see.

protocols.name: Global shortcuts (Hyprland)
protocols.description: Lets apps register shortcuts that work anywhere.

protocols.name: Virtual keyboard
protocols.description: Lets a program send key presses.

protocols.name: Virtual pointer
protocols.description: Lets a program move and click the pointer.

protocols.name: Input method
protocols.description: Lets an input method compose text for the focused app.
protocols.useful_for: Typing in other languages, emoji pickers

protocols.name: Text input
protocols.description: Connects text fields with input methods.

protocols.name: Cursor shape
protocols.description: Lets apps pick a named cursor that the compositor draws.

protocols.name: Pointer constraints
protocols.description: Locks the pointer in place or keeps it inside a window.

protocols.name: Relative pointer
protocols.description: Sends raw mouse movement.

protocols.name: Output management
protocols.description: Reads and changes monitor modes, positions and scale.

protocols.name: Output power
protocols.description: Turns monitors on and off.

protocols.name: Gamma control
protocols.description: Sets the color curves of a monitor.

protocols.name: Color transform (Hyprland)
protocols.description: Sets a color matrix for each monitor on Hyprland.

protocols.name: Fractional scale
protocols.description: Tells apps the exact scale, such as 125%.

protocols.name: Color management
protocols.description: Describes the color spaces of windows and monitors.

protocols.name: Tearing control
protocols.description: Lets fullscreen apps allow tearing for lower latency.

protocols.name: DRM lease
protocols.description: Hands a display directly to an app.

protocols.name: Linux DMA-BUF
protocols.description: Shares GPU buffers with the compositor without copying.
